matrix_unlock.note: Do not benchmark sandbox/disk/internet_disk matrices until a GLM-5.3 candidate has a complete current-protocol sandbox result.

profiles.disk: Only a synthetic read-only benchmark archive; never real home/chat/secrets.
profiles.internet_disk: Synthetic archive plus logged allow-listed web retrieval.

queued_models.requested_runtime: vLLM tensor_parallel_size=2 on physical V100 GPUs 1,2
queued_models.after: Complete the GLM-5.3 hardware matrix and current sandbox suite.
queued_models.blocker: Released FP8/FP4/DSpark weights exceed the 64 GiB V100 pair and SM70 lacks native FP8/FP4 inference kernels. CPU offload cannot provide those kernels.
queued_models.rule: Do not download or publish a t/s value unless infra/vllm_v100/preflight.py returns supported=true.

tensor_safety.llama_cpp_v100_tensor_split: Two long decode suites previously ended in a driver-level V100 hang. Causality below the driver boundary is unproven; unattended long runs use layer split.
tensor_safety.glm53_flash: Uses an experimental GLM runtime plus automatic CPU offload. It deliberately does not pass --tensor-split for the long hardware matrix.
tensor_safety.vllm_tensor_parallel: A distinct execution path from llama.cpp tensor split. It requires a model-specific SM70/format preflight before use.
